verdict.rationale: Fastmail's API is JMAP, which is pinned to fixed IETF RFC specifications (8620, 8621, 9610). Its session object advertises capabilities at runtime, a capability-based form of API versioning. The pack documents no explicit version scheme or deprecation/sunset policy, so only the stable-standard half of the story is evidenced. missing for 10: a documented deprecation policy with timelines, an explicit API versioning scheme or changelog, and independent corroboration of API stability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: Fetch `/.well-known/jmap` for the session object - capabilities, accounts, and all API URLs.
